📻 Lucille Ball swore this happened to her during World War II.

She was driving home from the studio one night when she heard music.

It wasn't the car radio.

It was coming from her mouth.

She'd just had new fillings put in, and she said they were picking up a radio station. https://t.co/sadeP1b8bJ

🤠 When Slim Pickens joined the Army Air Forces in WWII, the clerk asked him what he did for a living.

"Rodeo," he said.

The clerk wrote down "radio."

So the toughest rodeo clown in the West spent the whole war... at a radio station.

His real name was Louis Burton Lindley Jr. https://t.co/qiaqstSoqW
